summary: What to show where text is cut off: nothing, or an ellipsis.
details: It only shows when text actually overflows its box and is clipped. The classic single-line truncation needs three declarations together: white-space: nowrap, overflow: hidden and text-overflow: ellipsis.

values.note: Show … where the text is cut.

gotcha: On its own it does nothing: the text must be kept on one line (white-space: nowrap) and clipped (overflow: hidden). In a flex item, also add min-width: 0 so the item can get narrower than its text.
